alex: Heads-up — planning a short maintenance window for eu-west1 tonight 00:30–01:15 UTC to address recurring NIC latency spikes and to do a graceful rolling reboot of a small GPU cohort. Will do soft-drain + KV cache reseed to avoid cold-start token spikes. Notifying SRE, Support, and CS now.
maria: ETA and blast radius?
alex: ETA start 00:30 UTC. Cohort = pool-eu-gpu-5 (approx 18 nodes). We’ll move live tenants off via soft drain, keep capacity headroom >= 25% across region. No cross-region moves unless fallback triggers.
tim: can we stagger so RL tenants aren’t impacted? any canary?
alex: yes — 3-node canary first for 15m (00:30–00:45), then 3x stagger steps of ~15m each. Canary will exercise bursting traffic.
ravi: how do we seed KV cache after the node comes back? want to avoid search/latency blips for chat-heavy tenants.
alex: plan: after reboot, run `kv-seed` job to warm common prefixes + run a small synthetic traffic replay (500QPS for 60s) targeted at canary nodes. Then promote to next cohort. Script: 
```bash
for n in $(cat canary_nodes.txt); do ssh ubuntu@$n 'sudo systemctl start redwood-runtime && /opt/tools/kv-seed --model gpt-medium --prefix-file common-prefixes.txt'; done
```
sre-bot: Scheduled window created: eu-west1 maintenance 1746000001 (00:30 UTC) — reminder @channel 00:00 UTC. Reaction: :white_check_mark:
maria: cost / capacity note? we’re using reserved pools — if we drop below reserved commitments how bad is it?
tim: reserved capacity commitments kick in if effective available GPUs < commit threshold. we should avoid hitting that.
ravi: if canary shows degraded latency after reseed we should auto-fallback to smaller model variant on affected routes. Add rollback policy?
alex: yes, rollback = immediate traffic redirect to model-variant: gpt-medium-quantized with read-only KV cache (lower perf but stable). ops@ will monitor.
online-ops: tagging Support for customer comms now. Draft message in #customer-success for review.
deploy-bot: preflight check: node-drain-script: OK, kv-seed job: OK, canary-replay job: OK. No active critical deployments in eu-west1 between 23:45–02:00 UTC.
maria: any network handshake for egress NATs? last time egress reallocation caused transient failures for tenants using static egress ips.
alex: good call — we’ll run a NAT rebind sanity check after each node join. Command: `curl -sS http://169.254.169.254/metadata/egress-ip` to validate path, then synthetic request to external endpoints.
ravi: monitoring — what dashboards to watch?
alex: watch `infra.ecu.gpu.latency.p95`, `runtime.kv.cache.miss_rate`, `egress.router.error_rate`. Set short-lived alert thresholds: p95 > 150ms or kv miss_rate > 8% => pause rollout.
sre-bot: Alert policy cloned: eu-maint-short-window-policy. Pager escalation: oncall -> lead-sre -> eng-ops.
oncall-ops: Oncall is paged and will be present from 00:15–01:30 UTC.
tim: do we need to pre-warm prefix cache for large embedding jobs? those were the worst.
alex: included in `common-prefixes.txt`: top 100 prefixes from last 24h embeddings queries. Also seeding top-50 embedding vectors into LRU warmup.
maria: customer impact language? small chance of transient 5–10s tail latencies during canary only. No expected 5xx. If anything, we'll failover traffic to variant.
ravi: rollback runbook link?
alex: paste runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-maint-quick-rollback — includes `kubectl annotate` steps to switch route -> variant and prebuilt terraform to increase backfill capacity.
deploy-bot: Reminder will post 30m before window. Reaction: :bell:
maria: ack. I'll coordinate CS comms.
alex: final checklist — canary node list, kv prefix file, monitoring dashboards open, support message drafted, oncall present. If no objections, execute at 00:30 UTC.
tim: no objections from infra. go ahead.
ravi: thumbs up from runtime team.
oncall-ops: Oncall clear. Will watch pager.
sre-bot: Maintenance started (1746000001) — canary step initiated on nodes [canary-01, canary-02, canary-03].
alex: canary reboot went clean. kv-seed job finished; kv miss_rate fell from 9.4% -> 1.2%. Latency p95 stable. Proceeding with stage 2.
maria: keeping CS updated.
alex: stage 2 finished, stage 3 in progress.
ravi: noticed a small egress 502 spike for 45s during stage 2. any logs?
alex: pulling logs: `egress-proxy` showed a brief connection reset due to NAT sync. Fixed by rebind check. No customer errors propagated.
archival-bot: archived logs to s3://redwood-maint-logs/eu/1746000001.tar.gz
alex: wrap — window complete at 01:12 UTC. No customer-impacting incidents. Postmortem entry created and link sent to #postmortems. Thanks all :tada:
